data.description:
## Description

**What**: Extend provision-ruleset.sh with 5 named configuration knobs matching the manual Ruleset rules on this repo.
**Why**: Without configurable knobs, the Ruleset must be manually configured; this story makes Ruleset provisioning reproducible, idempotent, and aligned with this repo's settings.
**Scope**:
- IN: bypass_actor_policy (always|pull_request_only), require_conversation_resolution, request_copilot_review, dismiss_stale_approvals_on_push, required_approvals knobs; CodeQL and code-quality rules deferred (placeholder comment in provision-ruleset.sh)
- OUT: CI/CD workflow changes (S6); PR-mode merge (S3a/S3b); enforcement hook gating (S2)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, provision-ruleset.sh accepts 5 named knobs: bypass_actor_policy (always|pull_request_only), require_conversation_resolution, request_copilot_review, dismiss_stale_approvals_on_push, required_approvals
  <- Satisfies: "provision-ruleset.sh extended with config knobs matching the manual rules on this repo: bypass_actor_policy (always|pull_request_only), require_conversation_resolution, request_copilot_review, dismiss_stale_approvals_on_push, required_approvals"
- When this story is complete, CodeQL and code-quality rules are deferred with a placeholder comment in provision-ruleset.sh noting the follow-on epic
  <- Satisfies: "CodeQL and code-quality rules are deferred to a follow-on placeholder epic"
- When this story is complete, provision-ruleset.sh exits 1 with a clear error when insufficient token privileges for bypass_actor_policy changes
  <- Satisfies: implied by security consideration (privileged operation)
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Security] Bypass actor policy changes require admin token — provision-ruleset.sh must fail with a clear error when insufficient privileges

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a plugin maintainer, I can configure GitHub Ruleset knobs via provision-ruleset.sh
